in_sanskrit.name: Chauhan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Free, Generous
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chauhan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Originating from the Rajput clan, Chauhan is a name of great heritage and significance in Hindu culture. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'chahana', which means 'to desire or to demand'. Chauhan represents a free and generous spirit, one who is not afraid to ask for what they want and to fight for their rights. This name is often given to boys born into noble families or those who exhibit courage and strength in their character.
